mobile_crew_approval_allow_once: Primary button of a tool approval: allows this one call only.
mobile_crew_approval_allow_task: Allows the same kind of call for the rest of this task only. The next task asks again.
mobile_crew_approval_comment_hint: Hint inside the comment field of the answer sheet.
mobile_crew_approval_comment_label: Label of the comment field in the answer sheet; the agent receives it with the answer.
mobile_crew_approval_deny: Button that refuses a tool call.
mobile_crew_approval_failed: Snackbar when answering a tool approval fails with a text from the server. {reason} is that text.
mobile_crew_approval_more: Text button under a tool approval that opens the answer sheet (comment, Allow for this task).
mobile_crew_approval_rail_no_auto: Shown on an approval that a rail held: a GitHub or webhook task that has no allow_auto.
mobile_crew_approval_rail_protected_path: Shown on an approval that a rail held: the call touches .git internals, agent config, shell rc files, .env or key files.
mobile_crew_approval_sheet_title: Title of the answer sheet of a tool approval. {name} is the crewmate.
mobile_crew_approval_task_note: Note in the answer sheet explaining the scope of Allow for this task.
mobile_crew_approval_wants_to_run: First line of a tool approval from a crewmate. {tool} is the tool name, such as Bash.
mobile_crew_approval_wants_to_run_unknow: First line of a tool approval when hostd sent no tool name.
